prompt: A vertical 9:16 photo on cheap 35mm colour film with harsh direct on-camera flash: the live room of a tatty British recording studio flooded knee-deep with loose seven-inch vinyl singles, thousands of black discs and paper sleeves heaped like a ball pit, a drum kit and a mic stand half-sunk in the drift.
